[D3:7] Andrew: I hear ya. Can’t do that here unfortunately, city living makes it hard. Really miss that connection and companionship.

[D3:20] Audrey: Awesome! My dogs will tag along. My furry friends would love it!

[D3:22] Audrey: Same! Looking forward to it. This would be a good chance for you to hang out with them.
[D3:23] Andrew: Yeah! It's gonna be awesome to see all of them together and chowing down. Super excited!
[D3:24] Audrey: Yay! This'll be awesome! Seeing them all together, having fun and enjoying treats is the best. I can't imagine life without them, they bring so much joy.
[D3:24] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog running with three other dogs in the background
[D3:25] Andrew: Aww, so cute! I bet their happy faces means a lot to you.
[D3:26] Audrey: I know right? They mean the world to me. So much that I got tattoos of them on my arm.
[D3:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman with a tattoo of a dog and sunflowers

[D3:28] Audrey: Thanks! I got it a while ago. It represents my love for my pups and nature's beauty.
[D3:28] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a woman walking with her dogs in the woods
[D3:29] Andrew: Aww, that's cute! What made you getting the tattoo?
[D3:30] Audrey: I've always had a strong bond with them – they make me so happy, and I just want to see their happy faceseven when thry're not with me.
[D3:31] Andrew: That's awesome, I'm glad they bring so much joy into your life.
Session date: 5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023
[D4:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew! Long time no talk! Last week I finally went on a hike and had this amazing experience with a hummingbird. It was so cool watching it dart around with its wings! Nature is so beautiful.
[D4:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a hummingbird sitting on a branch with its wings spread
[D4:2] Andrew: Hey Audrey! Glad to hear from you. That hummingbird was awesome! Nature's the best. Remember I was feeling down because I couldn't get out more? Well, good news - I found a new open space to hike nearby - feels so refreshing!
[D4:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a view of a lake and mountains at sunset
[D4:3] Audrey: That looks great! How often are you able to go hiking now?
[D4:4] Andrew: So I usually try to escape the city at least once a weekend - it's my much-needed break!
[D4:5] Audrey: Nice! I Bet it's great to get away like that.
[D4:6] Andrew: Yep! Nature is so therapeutic for me. It's hard to put into words how great it feels to be surrounded by greenery or standing on top of a mountain breathing in the fresh air. So peaceful and invigorating.


[D4:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a mountain range with a sunset in the background
[D4:7] Audrey: Wow, that view looks great! It really captures that calming and peaceful feeling. It must be really satisfying to capture that tranquility.
[D4:8] Andrew: Yeah! I try to capture those special moments and share that feeling with others.
[D4:9] Audrey: That's really cool! Spreading that peaceful feeling to others is such a great way to bring happiness and motivation.
[D4:10] Andrew: I agree! It brings me joy to spread that feeling and motivate people to find their own peace - it's like a ripple effect, spreading positivity.
[D4:11] Audrey: Absolutely. Not only the receiving end feels great, the person spreading it will feel great as well!
[D4:12] Andrew: Yeah, it's crazy how that can bring such great joy and calm to people.
[D4:13] Audrey: Yeah, by sharing something can make a big difference to others.
[D4:14] Andrew: Yup! We don't realize it, but even the littlest gestures can have a big effect. Spreading good vibes and joy, that's the goal right? So what's up? Anything new or fun going on?
[D4:15] Audrey: Not much has changed since we last talked. I'm busy taking care of my pets and spending time with them. It's really fulfilling.
[D4:15] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a group of dogs sitting on top of a lush green field
[D4:16] Andrew: I bet it's awesome hanging out with them - do your dogs enjoy going on hikes?
[D4:17] Audrey: My dogs go nuts when we go on hikes! They love exploring new scents and being in nature - it's their happy place. I can tell by their wagging tails and expressions how much they love it. It's so great to see them having so much fun!
[D4:17] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog running in a field with other dogs
[D4:18] Andrew: Wow, that's great! I was wondering if you have any tips or tricks for keeping dogs safe when they're out and about?
[D4:19] Audrey: Definitely! Safety is super important for me. I even got them something special. They sure look funny, but it works!
[D4:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog with a leash and shoes on
[D4:20] Andrew: Awesome to see that you take such good care of your dogs! What else do you do when you walk them?
[D4:21] Audrey: When I take them out, we usually play fetch with a ball or frisbee. They love chasing it! We also meet other dog owners in the park and have a doggie playdate. It's a great way for me to chat with people and for them to make new friends.
[D4:21] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog catching a frisbee in a field
[D4:22] Andrew: Wow, looks like fun! They sure look excited about playing fetch!
[D4:23] Audrey: They absolutely adore it! They have tons of energy and love meeting new pals at playdates. Plus, they always get excited when I bring those out.
[D4:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog wearing a party hat sitting on a couch
[D4:24] Andrew: Aww, that's so cute! Do they enjoy wearing the party hats? And where did you find their playdates?

Session date: 7:09 pm on 1 October, 2023
[D20:17] Andrew: Cool! Let me know when you're ready to go birdwatching and we can plan a trip together.

[D20:27] Andrew: Yeah, nature is all connected. We as human being need look after it.
[D20:28] Audrey: Yeah! Taking care of the nature is like taking care of our house.
[D20:29] Andrew: Definitely, let's take care of it for future generations.
[D20:30] Audrey: It's on us to take care of it so the future generations have the natural resouorces.
[D20:31] Andrew: Yep, it's important to take care of it for future generations. Let's do our share! Do you recycle at all?
[D20:31] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a trash can sitting in the middle of a park
[D20:32] Audrey: Yeah of course! It's important for us to do our part, and recycling is a crucial step. Do you have any other suggestions?
[D20:33] Andrew: How about reducing our carbon footprint by biking or using public transport?
[D20:34] Audrey: Oh yeah! I usually take public transport, but biking sounds like a fun way to reduce our carbon footprint. Let's all give it a try and make a change!
[D20:35] Andrew: Yeah! It's a great way to help the planet and even train our body. Let's give it a try!
[D20:35] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man riding a bike down a street
[D20:36] Audrey: I'd love to try it sometime. Are there any good routes around here?
[D20:37] Andrew: Yep, there are some awesome routes near the river. Let me show you the best ones that I enjoy!
[D20:38] Audrey: Sounds great! Can you show me the best bike routes by the river? Thanks!
[D20:39] Andrew: Sure. There are many routes around the area.  I'll show you the best bike routes near there. It'll be great to get outside and soak up the scenery.
[D20:40] Audrey: Sounds great! Can't wait to check out those bike routes and soak up the scenery. It should be a blast!
Session date: 4:18 pm on 4 October, 2023
[D21:1] Andrew: Hi Audrey! Been a while since I hear from you. How's it been?
[D21:2] Audrey: Hey Andrew! It's been a wild ride! I did something fun with my pups over the weekend, took them to the beach and it was so fun to see them playing in the ocean.
[D21:3] Andrew: Sounds great! Did they love being at the beach? Did they enjoy the water? Here's a pic of my last trip to the beach.
[D21:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D21:4] Audrey: The dogs had a blast swimming at the beach! Have you been there lately?
[D21:5] Andrew: Haven't been to the beach in a while. Miss being outdoors. It's hard to find open spaces in the city. Used to hike a lot, but it's more challenging now with my work life balance.
[D21:6] Audrey: Oof, that's rough. I can imagine how much you miss being outdoors and surrounded by nature.
[D21:7] Andrew: Yeah, it's been tough. Exploring nature was my escape - a way to find peace. But with my job and living here, it's been harder to get that feeling back. I feel a void in my heart.
[D21:8] Audrey: Yeah, I get how it's like something is missing without being in the nature. But there are still some ways to appreciate it in the city, like getting some plants for your place or taking a trip to the park on the weekends.
[D21:9] Andrew: Yeah true. I should get some more plants for my house. Can't beat being outside tho, but they can still bring some peace. I'll look into it. Thanks for the tip!
[D21:10] Audrey: Of course! If you need help or advice, just let me know. Plants can make your home so peaceful.
[D21:11] Andrew: Thanks! I'll definitely reach out if I need any help or advice. Thanks again for offering!
[D21:12] Audrey: No problem at all! Glad to be of assistance.
[D21:13] Andrew: Oh you've helped so much. 
[D21:14] Audrey: Haha i'm just doing what I can do to help.
[D21:15] Andrew: Thank you really. Well, take care and say hi to your dogs for me.
[D21:16] Audrey: Haha I will. Take care. Talk later!
[D21:17] Andrew: Yup, have a great week. 
[D21:18] Audrey: Have a great week! Bye!
Session date: 9:41 pm on 6 October, 2023
[D22:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew, I was thinking about what you said about missing nature the other day. It reminded me of when I couldn't walk my dogs because of a knee injury. It was tough 'cause they bring me so much joy. This pic was taken after I started walking again. It felt great to be able to get back out there!
[D22:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth
[D22:2] Andrew: You know how it feel right? Bummer not being able to take them for a stroll. They must've been over the moon when you could finally take them out again. Glad you got that adorable pic too! Dogs are awesome like that, huh? Remind us to stop and smell the roses.
[D22:3] Audrey: Yeah, it was like they couldn't wait! They definitely reminds us to appreciate life's little pleasures. They see the world so differently!
[D22:4] Andrew: Yeah, dogs sure know how to find the simple joys of life! Appreciating the little things is so important. Well speaking of interesting hobbies, I rememver you mentionoed about that jewelry earlier? I remember you saying you make them with recycled objects. That sounds cool - tell me more!
[D22:5] Audrey: Oh yes! I love making jewelry out of recycled stuff. It's a great way to show my love of creativity and sustainability. I hunt down things like bottle caps, buttons, and broken jewelry, and then turn them into one-of-a-kind pieces. Here's a photo of one of my favorite necklaces. They all hold a special story and have their own appeal. Plus, it's a small step in reducing waste.
[D22:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman with a colorful necklace and earrings
[D22:6] Andrew: That necklace looks awesome! The colors really stand out and the design is really cool. It's great that you're giving recycled objects new life. Do you make jewelry to sell or just as a hobby? Also, do you donate profits to a good cause?
[D22:7] Audrey: Thanks! I started making jewelry as a hobby and then started selling it. I donate a portion of my profits to a cause that's close to my heart. It's a way to combine two of my passions - making jewelry and making a difference. It's great that customers not only enjoy my work but also support a cause!

[D19:14] Image caption (automatic): a photography of three small dogs sitting on a couch with a white fur

[D19:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a balcony with a bunch of flowers on it

[D19:22] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog laying on a wooden dock in a pond
[D19:23] Andrew: Awesome! Do they enjoy playing in the garden too?
[D19:24] Audrey: Yeah, they do enjoy the garden! Always running around, exploring and having a great time. So adorable!


[D19:24] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two dogs running in a grassy field
[D19:25] Andrew: Wow! Looks like they're having a blast. Are there any other furry pals they play with, or just the ones you have?

[D19:26] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog and a teddy bear sleeping on a couch
[D19:27] Andrew: Must be great having them around, the bond between you and them is awesome.
[D19:28] Audrey: Yeah, they do! They make everything so much better. Can't imagine life without them. They mean everything to me.
[D19:28] Image caption (automatic): a photography of three dogs sitting on a couch with a laptop in the background
[D19:29] Andrew: That's such a lovely picture, Audrey! So cute to see them snuggled up, having fun together. They really bring so much joy to our lives.

Session date: 7:09 pm on 1 October, 2023
[D20:1] Andrew: Hey wassup? Got some great news - the gf and I are hitting the beach next month with Toby!
[D20:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a sunset over the ocean with waves
[D20:2] Audrey: Hey Andrew! Great to hear from you. Have fun at the beach trip! Bet you can't wait to get out to the nature. Can't wait for our hike with the dogs next month. They always put a smile on my face - life's just not the same without them!
[D20:3] Andrew: Thanks, I will! Yea I can't wait for the hike. It's been a long time since we all be in nature together.
[D20:4] Audrey: Being in a nature environment is always a great way to relax. For me, taking the doggos out for a walk in the park helps clear my mind and find some peace. It's been tough lately, but it definitely helps.
[D20:4] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a group of dogs sitting on top of a lush green field
[D20:5] Andrew: Aww, they look so cute! That spot looks ideal for them to play. Where did you take them?
[D20:6] Audrey: We took them to the dog park nearby last Saturday. There was a big grassy area for them to play and lots of shaded spots for me to relax. They had a great time!
[D20:7] Andrew: Sounds great! Missing that experience. Can't wait for the coming up hike!
[D20:8] Audrey: Yeah, Andrew! The pups and I are loving it. Being out in nature and checking out new trails with the dogs is so different from being in the city.
[D20:9] Andrew: I think everyone's gotta ditch the hustle and bustle every now and then. It's so refreshing to be in nature.
[D20:10] Audrey: Yep, it's a relief. It's like being a bird and finally flying free. Talking of birds, have you seen any birds up close lately?
[D20:11] Andrew: I've seen them up close and it's amazing how they fly with grace and freedom.
[D20:12] Audrey: Yeah, birds are really amazing! I love how they can fly around and explore. They have a freedom that I wish I had!
[D20:13] Andrew: Agreed! Watching them fly is so freeing and awe-inspiring. It's a great reminder to appreciate nature.
[D20:14] Audrey: Yeah, for sure. It's a great way to appreciate nature. That reminds me that I've been wanting to do some birdwatching. It's really peaceful and calming.
[D20:15] Andrew: Yeah do that! It's really peaceful and calming. It's nice to get away from the city and enjoy nature. Let me know if you need any birdwatching advice, I think I know a thing or two about bird watching. Or perhaps we can all go birdwatching soometimes.
[D20:16] Audrey: Thanks! That's so helpful, I'd love to take you up on your offer. Right now I'm going with this book that writes about bird watching guides. 
[D20:16] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a book with a page of birds and a bird on it

[D25:15] Andrew: Haha! You're welcomoe! Have a good one!

Session date: 2:36 pm on 28 October, 2023
[D26:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew, I wanted to let you know about something going on with my dogs. I noticed they weren't acting normally, so I made an appointment with an animal behaviorist last Wed. It's been a bit hectic but I'm hopeful it'll help me better understand them.
[D26:2] Andrew: Oh no! Sorry to hear that your dogs haven't been themselves. Are they doing ok? How did the appointment with the animal behaviorist go? Did you receive any helpful advice or insights?
[D26:3] Audrey: The appointment went okay. It was hectic at first, but the behaviorist checked them out and asked some questions. I got some tips to try and help with their problems now.
[D26:4] Andrew: So what tips did you get? What will you be doing to help with the problems?
[D26:5] Audrey: The behaviorist gave me tips on how to handle it and suggested some changes in their routine. I'm using positive reinforcement techniques and it's still a work in progress, but I'm hopeful it'll help.
[D26:6] Andrew: I'm glad your pups are still good with positive reinforcement! How are they doing with the new approach tho?
[D26:7] Audrey: So far they seem to be responding well to it! It won't be fixed immediately but I'm seeing some progress. Here's hoping it keeps going.
[D26:8] Andrew: That's good to hear! Keep up the good work!
[D26:9] Audrey: Thanks! Your words of encouragement really mean a lot. It's tough, but I'm devoted to keeping them healthy and happy - they mean everything to me.
[D26:10] Andrew: You're doing a great job! They're lucky to have you.
[D26:11] Audrey: Thanks! They're really special to me and I want the best for them. Here's a pic of them having a blast last summer, so happy! I'm looking forward the day they are back to normal.
[D26:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth
[D26:12] Andrew: Aww, they're having such a blast! What kind are they? I'm wishing you and your pups the best. 
[D26:13] Audrey: Thanks! They're all mutts, but Pepper and Panda are Lab mixes, and Precious and Pixie are Chihuahua mixes. I really need that. I can't wait the day they're all back to normal.
[D26:14] Andrew: Sending prayers and wishes. Here's a pic I took at a national park I went a while ago.
[D26:14] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a man hiking up a mountain with a backpack

Session date: 11:27 am on 2 June, 2023
[D7:6] Andrew: Wow, incredible sunset and the scenery! Must have been magical. Thanks for sharing!
[D7:7] Audrey: It was really special. Nature always cheers me up and makes me feel grateful. Glad you could experience it too. Oh, how are things going with your search for a furry friend?
[D7:8] Andrew: I'm still on the hunt, but it's tough finding a pet-friendly spot in the city. Been checking out some places, but no luck so far. A bit discouraged but I'm determined to find the right place and dog.
[D7:9] Audrey: Oof, Hang in there, you'll find the perfect place for you and your new furry friend.
[D7:10] Andrew: Thanks! I won't give up. 
[D7:11] Audrey: I'm here to support! Email me your criterias so I can help you find a great spot for your furry friend.
[D7:12] Andrew: Thanks! Your assistance is greatly appreciated. So thankful for your help.
[D7:13] Audrey: Not a problem at all! We'll keep searching. Stay positive!
Session date: 5:23 pm on 13 June, 2023
[D8:1] Andrew: Hey! Long time no chat. Last Sunday was awesome - my friends and I took a rock climbing class and I made it to the top! It was a fantastic experience and now I'm hooked. Think I'm going to try to do more outdoor activities like this every week!
[D8:2] Audrey: That's awesome! Glad you had such a rad experience rock climbing. I'm always in awe of people who can climb mountains. Got any pics or videos from your climb? Would love to see the view from the top!
[D8:3] Andrew: Rock climbing was awesome! It was a challenge, but so satisfying. The view was stunning, and I was really proud of myself. Nature sure is amazing!

[Shares a photo of the view from the top of the rock climbed during the rock climbing class]
[D8:3] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a man climbing on a rock face to face
[D8:4] Audrey: Wow that view is stunning! Congrats on reaching the top, that must have been a huge accomplishment. Nature really reminds us how tiny we are in comparison, yeah? Was it challenging getting there?
[D8:5] Andrew: Thanks! It was a big achievement for me. The climb was tricky, especially since I'm still a newbie. But I made it with the support and cheer from my friends.
[D8:6] Audrey: Nice! Having a solid support group really helps when things get tough. You're lucky to have such great friends! Does this adventure encourage you to try more outdoor activities?
[D8:7] Andrew: Yeah, rock climbing was awesome - I felt so accomplished reaching the top. It has definitely encouraged me to try more outdoor activities like kayaking and maybe bungee jumping? Nature always pushes me out of my comfort zone!
[D8:8] Audrey: Wow going all in huh? Have fun with kayaking and bungee jumping! Last week, I found a great spot for my dogs' walk. It's a small park with a trail surrounded by trees. It's so nice and I think my dogs like it too. Would you like to come along?
[D8:9] Andrew: Sounds great, Audrey! I'd love to join you and your pups for a walk. Being in nature with dogs sounds like a great time!
[D8:10] Audrey: Awesome! Can't wait to have fun with everyone. My dogs love meeting new people. 
[D8:11] Andrew: Sames, can't wait to meet them and take a stroll in the park.
[D8:12] Audrey: This was taken during the walk in the park. See how happy they are?
[D8:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth
[D8:13] Andrew: Aww, they look like they're really enjoying themselves. How long do you usually walk them for?
[D8:14] Audrey: Varies depending on the day, but usually for about an hour. We let them explore at their own pace.
[D8:15] Andrew: Cool, that's a good amount of time for them to have a nice stroll and take a look around.
[D8:16] Audrey: They need exercise and to explore - they always go home with a smile and tired.
[D8:17] Andrew: Nice! Letting them explore and have fun is important. I'm sure they must be loving it!
[D8:18] Audrey: Yeah, they love it! It's their favorite part of the day! Their faces blightens up as soon as I get ready for a walk.
[D8:19] Andrew: Of course! Nature always makes us and our pets so happy.
[D8:20] Audrey: Definitely! Dogs and nature bring me so much joy and peace.
[D8:21] Andrew: Yeah, I agree, it's really nice.
[D8:22] Audrey: So check out how happy they are in this meadow! They make me so happy.
[D8:22] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs playing with a frisbee in a field
[D8:23] Andrew: Aww so cute. Your dogs look so content in that picture. The meadow looks so nice. It's great that nature brings your pets joy!
[D8:24] Audrey: Being outdoors with them puts me in my happy place. It's peaceful and inspiring.
[D8:25] Andrew: Glad you found something that puts you in your happy place. It's true, being outdoors has a way of inspiring and calming us.
[D8:26] Audrey: Yeah! It's incredible how nature can make us think differently.
[D8:27] Andrew: Agreed! It's great for refreshing the mind and giving a different outlook. Whenever I'm in need of a reset, I turn to nature.
[D8:28] Audrey: Nature has a way of making us feel alive and centered. Let's appreciate what it gives us.
Session date: 1:51 pm on 26 June, 2023
[D9:1] Audrey: Woohoo! I got a new place with a bigger backyard for the pooches! Take a look!
[D9:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two dogs sitting on the grass in front of a house
[D9:2] Andrew: That's awesome! Your new place looks great. Your fur babies must be thrilled with the bigger backyard. I'm sure they're having a blast running around. How are they settling in?
[D9:3] Audrey: Thanks! They love it - so much space to run and explore, sniffing out new smells. It's awesome to see them having fun.
[D9:4] Andrew: Awesome! They must love it. Makes me happy seeing them have fun. Any plans on making it even more pup-friendly?
[D9:5] Audrey: Yep, I set up a doggy play area in the backyard with agility stuff and toys - they're loving it!
[D9:6] Andrew: Wow you really went in huh!?  Now they have a great place to play and explore, that's awesome! Take a look at this place I'm at.
[D9:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of dogs playing with a ball in a large indoor area
[D9:7] Audrey: That looks fun! Where are you at? I would love to take the dogs there sometime soon.
[D9:8] Andrew: This is the doggy daycare near me, it has a big indoor space for dogs to play.
[D9:9] Audrey: Ooo, I'll definitely take a look at it. Thanks for the tip.
[D9:10] Andrew: Not a problem at all! Let me know if you need any help finding more places for dogs.
[D9:11] Audrey: Thanks! Appreciate the offer. Super nice to have friends who understand our love for our pets!
[D9:12] Andrew: Haha yeah! People who understand the love for dogs are awesome. They really bring so much joy!
[D9:13] Audrey: Right!? Animals are great! They really bring so much joy. Can't imagine life without them!
[D9:14] Andrew: Yeah, I'm glad we both appreciate them. Not everyone feel this way.
[D9:15] Audrey: For sure! I don't really get some people hating on pets or even hurting them. They're like family to people.
[D9:16] Andrew: Definitely! So what's new with you? Anything going on lately? Take a look at this park in my neighborhood that has these flowers.
[D9:16] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a flower bed with many different colored flowers
[D9:17] Audrey: Oh wow those flowers look beautiful. Well aside from moving to a new house, its just me getting unboxing all the packed boxes. What about you?
[D9:18] Andrew: Last Friday, I hiked with some friends. The weather was great and it felt so good to be outdoors. We got some awesome pictures too.
